notes.title: 50% off? 75% off?! You betcha!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44264647/60cc34c8cf76f354d889054623ce6273afc25db7.gif[/img]

We got the nod from the boss. The rumours are true. A chilling breeze, sweeps through town. Yes. Cape Hideous, by Melbourne artist and indie game dev Jake Clover, is 75% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3187550/Cape_Hideous

You may also be interested to know, that Nonsense Machine's largest and most ambitious project to date, Dryft City Kyngs, is also 50% off. Hey don't look at me, I'm just a little bird!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2136770/Dryft_City_Kyngs

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3052350/Dryft_City_Kyngs_Soundtrack/

Oh? You're still here? Are these offerings not enough to entice you to part with your gold? Well. I guess we'll go our separate ways then OH WAIT - every other Nonsense Machine game and soundtrack under the sun is also 50% off! See for yourself, below.

[previewyoutube=veqwnB8rw9s;full][/previewyoutube]

For your convenience, we have created some digital teleportation portals leading to products you may like to purchase. HEY. MY DEALS ARE DOWN HERE.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928450/dweeMIXED_Thwee_Pack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1314980/Mealmates/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/855530/New_Ice_York/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/564810/Ticket/

"Have a good one."
~dweedes, 2025

notes.title: All our games are 50% off!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/nonsensemachine][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44264647/960308fd6255ac6fd7d191b54dfb8b492d4ef2c5.png[/img][/url]

Down here it's our time. It's [i]*our*[/i] time, down here. The underground indie gaming tome, [b]dweeMIXED: Thwee Pack[/b], comprising of three cornerstones of humanity, is available for half of its true objective value - but only for a limited time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928450/dweeMIXED_Thwee_Pack/

Further to this historical sale, the individual components of the Thwee Pack are also available at half price: freaky multiplayer mayhem [b]Mealmates[/b], ice cold detective drama [b]New Ice York[/b], and enchanting otherworldly adventure [b]Ticket[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1314980/Mealmates/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/855530/New_Ice_York/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/564810/Ticket/

"What about the music?" you ask. Fear not. The soni-auditorial masterworks bringing an extra dimension to these games are, yes, half their usual cost as well. Incredible. Oh, but wait, what's this?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2136770/Dryft_City_Kyngs/][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44264647/def85836bdfd8183a8445157ae973634868a161d.png[/img][/url]

Ah but of course. The Dryft City Kyngs Demo is available to play for fr$$. We prescribe a full weekend of playing only this demo, with no distractions such as hunger, thirst, or lust. In order to gain maximum enjoyment of this multimedia experience, you must also wishlist the game, a means to which we have conveniently provided below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2136770/Dryft_City_Kyngs/

See you on the higher plane.
Nonsense Machine
